import Mathlib

theorem p09 (n : ℕ) : 7 ∣ 8 ^ n - 1 := by
  induction n with
  | zero => norm_num
  | succ n ih =>
      rcases ih with ⟨k, hk⟩
      refine ⟨8 * k + 1, ?_⟩
      rw [pow_succ]
      have hpos : 1 ≤ 8 ^ n := by positivity
      omega
